text:
maria: Heads up — proposal for a sensor-driven fallback circuit for canaries. Short thread with examples + API sketch. TL;DR: fallback decisions should be decoupled from rollout weight and expressed as 'circuits' that can trigger variant swap / region reroute / degrade-to-minimal.

aj: Love it. Can you sketch signals? CPU/GPU saturation, p95/p99 latency, error-rate, QPS per-model, eval-quality-drop (BLEU/ROUGE/bertscore), token-cost-per-request?

maria: Yes: we group signals into buckets: perf (latency, GPU util), correctness (eval metrics, hallucination detector), cost (token burn), infra (region capacity), contract (SLA violations). Each circuit has aggregator (avg/p95/score), window, and threshold.

leo: @maria do we allow multi-signal gates (AND/OR)?

maria: Yes. Want boolean algebra + hysteresis to prevent flipflop. Also 'soft tripping' which reduces canary weight in steps instead of instant 100% failover.

sarah: From UX side — we need preflight sim in console and live 'risk meter'. Also one-click emergency 'degrade-to-minimal' variant + ability to keep canary running for diagnostics.

ben: How do we express in API? YAML? JSON? I'd prefer a compact DSL.

maria: Sketch below — infra proposal (very compact):

```yaml
rollout:
  id: r-2026-07
  targets:
    - variant: v2-quant
      weight: 10
  circuits:
    - id: c_perf
      signals: [p99_latency_ms, gpu_util]
      aggregator: max
      window: 30s
      trigger:
        op: '>'
        value: 120
      on_trip:
        action: reduce_weight
        params: {percent: 50, step: 10}
    - id: c_region
      signals: [region_capacity]
      aggregator: min
      window: 1m
      trigger: {op: '<', value: 20}
      on_trip: {action: reroute_region, target: next_region}
```

maria: Important: circuits evaluated per-route+customer. Per-customer exemptions via labels.

pete: @maria what about sticky sessions? If we reroute region mid-session we must migrate KV cache or fall back to stateless path.

maria: Good call. Plan: session affinity preserved for 'grace period' + 'drain' policy. If action is reroute_region then we mark sessions as 'migrating' and keep old nodes for X minutes.

deploy-bot: deploy notice: A/B rollout r-2026-07 created by @maria -> v2-quant 10%

aj: Edge case: canary increases latency slightly but improves quality. We need QoQ: tradeoff tunable in circuit (e.g., net_score = w1*quality - w2*latency).

sarah: Console needs slider: quality_vs_cost weight.

ben: Implementation note: aggregator functions need streaming foldable decaying windows. Can't afford full hist merge per request.

leo: Agree. Use t-digest for latency, reservoir for errors, exponential decay for util.

maria: Also want audit logs (why a circuit tripped + snapshot of signals) and auto-create incident with runbook link.

ops: Ops note: We'll need rate-limit guard so fallback doesn't overload target pool. Suggested to combine action 'scale_then_reroute'.

pete: Testing plan: unit tests for circuit logic + chaos tests that simulate partial GPU loss + integration with console preview.

sarah: UX: add 'simulate trip' button that shows predicted downstream impact.

maria: Next steps: I'll open PR with API defs + console mocks. Ask platform infra to review perf cost of additional signal telemetry. @aj @leo please review data model for signals. If no major objections we'll start implementation wk of 2026-04-06.

aj: I'll review. Quick Q: default hysteresis: 3 consecutive windows?

leo: Sounds fine.

maria: Thanks all :tada:
